items.text: INkosi yasikhuluma kuMozisi enkangala yeSinayi ethenteni lenhlangano, ngolokuqala lwenyanga yesibili, ngomnyaka wesibili emva kokuphuma kwabo elizweni leGibhithe, yathi:
Balani inani lenhlangano yonke yabantwana bakwa-Israyeli ngemindeni yabo nangezindlu zawoyise, nenani lamagama abo, bonke abesilisa ngemindeni yabo;
kusukela kwabaneminyaka engamashumi amabili kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma impi kwa-Israyeli; wena no-Aroni niyakubabala ngokwamabutho abo.
Kuyakuba nawe indoda esizweni; yilowo nalowo inhloko yendlu yawoyise.
Lawa angamagama amadoda ayakuma nani: esizweni sakwaRubeni; u-Elisuri indodana kaSedewuri.
KuSimeyoni; uShelumiyeli indodana kaSurisadayi.
KwaJuda; uNashoni, indodana ka-Aminadaba.
Kwa-Isakare; uNethaneli indodana kaSuwari.
KwaZebuloni; u-Eliyabe indodana kaHeloni.
Kubantwana bakwaJosefa: kwa-Efrayimi; u-Elishama indodana ka-Amihudi wakwaManase; uGamaliyeli indodana kaPedasuri.
KwaBenjamini; u-Abidani indodana kaGideyoni.
KwaDani; u-Ahiyezeri indodana ka-Amisadayi.
Kwa-Asheri; uPagiyeli indodana ka-Okirani.
KwaGadi; u-Eliyasafa indodana kaDehuweli.
KwaNafetali; u-Ahira, indodana ka-Enani.
Laba babeyizikhulu zebandla, izikhulu zezizwe zawoyise, izinhloko zezinkulungwane kwa-Israyeli.
OMose no-Aroni bathatha lawa madoda ayebalulwe ngamagama;

Balibizela ndawonye ibandla lonke ngolokuqala lwenyanga yesibili, babhala izizukulwane zabo ngemindeni yabo nangezindlu zawoyise njengokomumo wamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engamashumi amabili kuya phezulu; ngokusho kwamabhokisi abo okuvota.
Njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose, wababala ehlane laseSinayi.

Abantwana bakoRubeni, izibulo likaIsrayeli, ngensendo zabo, ngezizukulwana zabo, ngezindlu zaboyise, ngokwenani lamabizo, njengabavoti babo, bonke abesilisa, kusukela kwabangamashumi amabili. Abaneminyaka yobudala nangaphezulu, bonke abangaphuma ukuya empini;
ababalwayo kubo besizwe sakwaRubeni, baba ngamashumi amane anesithandathu amawaka, anamakhulu mahlanu.

Kubantwana bakwaSimeyoni, izizukulwane zabo ngezizukulwane zabo nangezindlu zawoyise, labo ababalwayo ngenani lamagama, ngokwezinhlu zabo, bonke abesilisa kusukela kwabaneminyaka engamashumi amabili ubudala. Nangaphezulu, bonke abangaphuma impi;
ababalwayo kubo besizwe sakwaSimeyoni, baba ngamashumi amahlanu anesithoba amawaka, anamakhulu mathathu.
Kubantwana bakwaGadi ngemindeni yabo ngezizukulwane zabo nangezindlu zawoyise ngokwenani lamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engamashumi amabili kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma;
ababalwayo kubo besizwe sakwaGadi, baba ngamashumi amane anamahlanu amawaka, anamakhulu mathandathu, anamanci mahlanu.
Kubantwana bakwaJuda ngemindeni yabo ngezizukulwane zabo ngezindlu zawoyise njengokomumo wamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engamashumi amabili kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma;
ababalwayo kubo besizwe sakwaJuda, ababalwayo kubo, baba yizinkulungwane eziyishumi nane namakhulu ayisithupha.
Kubantwana bakwa-Isakare ngemindeni yabo ngezizukulwane zabo ngezindlu zawoyise ngokwenani lamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engamashumi amabili kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma;
ababalwayo kubo besizwe sakwaIsakare, baba ngamashumi amahlanu anamane amawaka, anamakhulu mane.
Kubantwana bakwaZebuloni, ngemindeni yabo, ezizukulwaneni zabo nangezindlu zawoyise ngokwenani lamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engamashumi amabili kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma;
ababalwayo kubo besizwe sakwaZebhulon, baba ngamashumi amahlanu anesixhenxe amawaka, anamakhulu mane.

Kubantwana bakoJosefa, abantwana bakoEfrayimi, ngensendo zabo, ngezizukulwane zabo, ngezindlu zaboyise, ngokwenani lamabizo, kusukela koleminyaka engamatshumi amabili langaphezulu, bonke aba negunya. Ukuphuma ukuya empini;
ababalwayo kubo besizwe sakwaEfrayim, baba ngamashumi amane amawaka, anamakhulu mahlanu.
Kubantwana bakoManase, ngensendo zabo, ngezizukulwana zabo, ngezindlu zaboyise, ngokwenani lamagama, kusukela koleminyaka engamatshumi amabili langaphezulu, bonke aba nga phuma;
ababalwayo kubo besizwe sakwaManase, baba ngamashumi amathathu anamabini amawaka, anamakhulu mabini.
Kubantwana bakwaBenjamini, izizukulwane zabo ngezizukulwane zabo ngezindlu zoyise ngokwenani lamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engamashumi amabili kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma;
ababalwayo kubo besizwe sakwaBenjamini, baba ngamashumi amathathu anamahlanu amawaka, anamakhulu mane.
Kubantwana bakwaDani ngemindeni yabo ngezizukulwane zabo ngezindlu zawoyise ngokwenani lamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engamashumi amabili kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma;
ababalwayo kubo besizwe sakwaDan, baba ngamashumi omathandathu anamabini amawaka, anamakhulu asixhenxe.
Kubantwana bakwa-Asheri ngemindeni yabo ngezizukulwane zabo ngezindlu zawoyise njengokomumo wamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engamashumi amabili kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma;
ababalwayo kubo besizwe sakwa-Ashere, baba ngamashumi amane ananye amawaka, anamakhulu mahlanu.
Kubantwana bakwaNafetali ngemindeni yabo ngezizukulwane zabo ngemindeni yabo ngokwenani lamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engamashumi amabili kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma;
ababalwayo kubo besizwe sakwaNafetali, baba ngamashumi amahlanu anamathathu amawaka, anamakhulu mane.
Yilabo ababalwayo oMose, no-Aroni, nezikhulu zakwa-Israyeli, amadoda ayishumi nambili; kwaba yilowo nalowo eyendlu yawoyise.
Baba kanjalo bonke ababalwayo babantwana bakwa-Israyeli ngokwezindlu zoyise, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engamashumi amabili kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma baye kwa-Israyeli;
Bonke ababalwayo babe yizinkulungwane ezingamakhulu ayisithupha nantathu namakhulu amahlanu namashumi amahlanu.
Kodwa amaLevi ngokwesizwe soyise kababalwanga phakathi kwabo.
Ngokuba uJehova wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
Kuphela nje ungasibali isizwe sakwaLevi, ungathathi umumo waso phakathi kwabantwana bakwa-Israyeli.

Kodwa kumelwe ubeke amaLevi phezu kwetabernakele lobufakazi naphezu kwazo zonke izitsha zalo naphezu kwakho konke okungokwalo; kumelwe bathwale itabernakele nazo zonke izinto zalo; bayakulikhonza, balimise nxazonke zetabernakele.
Lapho itabernakele lisuka, amaLevi kumelwe alidilize; ekumisweni kwetabernakele, amaLevi alimise; futhi umfokazi osondelayo kumelwe abulawe.
Abantwana bakwa-Israyeli bayakumisa amatende abo, kube yilowo nalowo ngekamu lakhe, kube yilowo nalowo njengophawu lwakhe ngamabandla abo.
Kodwa amaLevi ayakumisa nxazonke zetabernakele lobufakazi, funa kufike ulaka phezu kwenhlangano yabantwana bakwa-Israyeli; amaLevi ayakugcina inkonzo yetende lobufakazi.
Abantwana bakwa-Israyeli benza-ke njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose, benze njalo-ke.
